material.acceptance_criteria: A STATE frame round-trips a unit type per unit; a remote client draws the model from unit_model_names for that type; witnessed by a CI job over two peers.
material.description: The wire frame (js/wire/frame.js, js/client/wire/frame.js) carries no unit type, so remote clients cannot pick the model per unit; local play draws models (moba-glb-units closed).
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-6-v1-model: green run 39070142945 job 117506155308 prints 'browser remote model ok unit=0 type=0'; frame files identical.
material.subject: Networked units carry their unit type so remote clients draw the right GLB model
material.witness: verifier gm-orch-6-v1-model: green run 39070142945 job 117506155308 prints 'browser remote model ok unit=0 type=0'; frame files identical.
material.witness_plan: node js/wire/test.js round-trip with unit types, plus the browser-two-peers job asserting a remote unit's model name.
